description: The column types of the two tables a TimeToShare package keeps beside its manifest, as Apache Arrow types. Each type of `types` is a struct of named members, in order, or the struct read from the schema it names. Each table of `tables` has a `status` (`stable`: under the version promise of the format; `experimental`: outside it, free to change in any version) and its `columns`, in order, each with its `name`, its `type` (a type name of `string`, `bool`, `int64` or `float64`, Arrow's utf8, bool, int64 and double, or a name of `types`) and whether it is `nullable`. A column that is not nullable holds no null in any row; its Arrow field may still be declared nullable. A table may hold further columns, which a reader keeps and never checks.

number.description: A number, filled by its number type and never mirrored: an int is its numerator alone, a fraction its numerator and its denominator (at least 1), a float its finite value alone; every other member is null.

coordinate.description: A coordinate on one timeline's axis: the members of a number, then its unit and its number type.

anchor.description: An AlignmentAnchor: one coordinate on each of the row's two timelines, coordinate_a on its timeline_a_id, coordinate_b on its timeline_b_id.

projection_of.description: The event a Projection stands for, by its timeline and its ID.

provenance.description: A row's provenance: a struct of the provenance schema's properties, in its order; a property of type array is a list (of the struct of the Belief's properties, each a string, for beliefs; of strings otherwise), every other property a string.

MatchClaim.description: The MatchClaim table: one row per MatchClaim, addressed by its ID alone. A MatchClaim table belongs to one manifest. Each side's `event_a_id` or `event_b_id` holds the ID of an event or the reserved string of a sentinel, never a null: `CHUNK_SENTINEL` on a side of a synchronous MatchClaim, whose timeline holds no event for the coordinate its anchors state there; `NOMATCH_SENTINEL` on one side of a MatchClaim that is not synchronous, which has no anchors. A sentinel side has no name, and no element has a reserved string as its ID.

Projection.description: The Projections table: one row per Projection, its unit and number type stated once for its start and its duration; duration null for an instant.
